title: MIB Task Coverage Audit: Measuring What Circuit Benchmarks Leave Out

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If benchmark rankings reverse on out-of-distribution tasks, the field may be optimizing for a non-representative problem slice. Identifying this directly motivates expanding MIB. Clear chain from gap analysis to improved benchmark design to more reliable safety-relevant circuit claims.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: All methods and models are available in TransformerLens. GPT-2-Small is lightweight. However, setting up new tasks with proper concept datasets and running multiple discovery methods requires familiarity with ACDC, path patching, and attribution patching codebases. Moderate complexity for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two to three new tasks, three discovery methods, and comparison across all combinations. The deliverable (gap analysis table) is clear but the experimental matrix is a 3x3 grid minimum. Could be narrowed to two methods and two tasks to fit 30 hours.
